widget.name: Native Vision Camera
widget.description: Designed from the ground up to provide all features a camera app should have. You have full control over what device is used, and can even configure options such as frame rate, colorspace and more.

property.caption: Media path
property.description: Attribute to store the path of the temp media file.

property.caption: Capture action
property.description: Logic for handling the captured media.

property.caption: Photo orientation
property.description: Device: follow the physical orientation of the device (sensors), even when the app is locked to one orientation. Preview: use the orientation of the camera preview, so the photo always matches what the user sees. Choose Preview for apps that are locked to landscape or portrait.
